# Forbidden fixture (the content-rules guard must flag every line below)

Each line trips one rule of tools/content_rules/terms.yaml in a harmless kitchen or office
setting, so the fixture itself carries no out-of-bounds content.

- lab-operation: Reflux the soup gently before serving.
- reaction-chemistry: Note the reaction temperature on the recipe card.
- physical-constants: Water's boiling point is a classroom fact.
- lab-equipment: Wash the glassware after the cooking class.
- lab-quantity: Add 5 g of sugar to the tea.
- temperature: Bake the bread at 200 °C.
- yield-figure: The sourdough recipe has a yield of 2 loaves.
- ratio: Mix flour and water in a 2:1 ratio by weight.
- deposit-structuring: The training slide defined smurfing as a word to avoid.
- trade-invoicing: The supplier was accused of over-invoicing the stationery.
- concealment: The magician's box had a false compartment.
- torture: The long meeting tortured everyone.
- graphic-violence: The horror film was gory.
- harm-to-children: The story harmed no one, but the phrase child labour trips the rule.
